citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The new enclosure for the crows has not been reviewed and visited by the attending veterinarian at this site. It was
assembled and occupied by the crows since the last veterinary visit earlier this year. Each exhibitor shall have a formal
arrangement with regularly scheduled visits to the premises of the exhibitor in order to assure the welfare of the animals.
Correct by 14 August 26 or before the next scheduled relicense inspection.
This is a 1st Re-License Inspection for a Class “C” license. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the
applicant.
Regulated activity may continue at all regulated sites until the expiration of the current license on 28 August 2026. At that
time, conducting regulated activity from any site without a valid USDA license is a violation of the Animal Welfare Act.
All items must be in compliance within 2 more inspections or by 26 September 2026 or the applicant will forfeit the license
fee and must wait 6 months to reapply. Please contact your inspector to schedule your next Re-License Inspection.
Regulated activity can continue under your existing USDA license until it expires.
